## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Scientific or statistical rationale

Explain the estimand, supported designs, assumptions, limitations, and
reference method where applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m ruff check src tests`
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check src tests`
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m pip check`
- [ ] Public API changes are documented
- [ ] Changelog is updated when appropriate
- [ ] New or changed methods include valid references
- [ ] Tests include boundary and failure cases
- [ ] No confidential or identifying data are included

## Compatibility and dependencies

Describe any Python-version, dependency, plugin, API, or licensing impact.
